# Configuration options

The mapper-wide configuration, and the configuration behind each generated type.

## `StrawchemyConfig` {#strawchemy-config-base-StrawchemyConfig}

[source](https://github.com/gazorby/strawchemy/blob/v0.24.0/src/strawchemy/config/base.py#L20)

```python
StrawchemyConfig(dialect: SupportedDialect, session_getter: AnySessionGetter = default_session_getter, auto_snake_case: bool = True, repository_type: AnyRepositoryType = StrawchemySyncRepository, filter_overrides: FilterMap | None = None, execution_options: dict[str, Any] | None = None, default_id_field_name: str = 'id', deterministic_ordering: bool = True, strict: bool = True, auto_is_type_of: bool = True, include: FieldSpec = 'all', exclude: FieldSpec | None = None, pagination: FieldSpec | None = None, order_by: FieldSpec | None = None, distinct_on: FieldSpec | None = None, pagination_default_limit: int = 100, pagination_default_offset: int = 0) -> None
```

Global configuration for Strawchemy.

### `auto_is_type_of` {#strawchemy-config-base-StrawchemyConfig-auto_is_type_of}

```python
auto_is_type_of: bool = True
```

Auto-generate is_type_of (an isinstance check against the model) on mapped
output object types so they work as GraphQL Union / interface members without
boilerplate. A user-defined is_type_of on the decorated class is always
respected. Set to False to disable globally.

### `auto_snake_case` {#strawchemy-config-base-StrawchemyConfig-auto_snake_case}

```python
auto_snake_case: bool = True
```

Automatically convert snake cased names to camel case

```python

```

### `strict` {#strawchemy-config-base-StrawchemyConfig-strict}

```python
strict: bool = True
```

When False, silently skip (and warn about) model columns whose type hint has no GraphQL
mapping, instead of failing the schema build. Explicit `type_overrides` are always honored.
Note: types mapped only via `strawberry.Schema(scalar_overrides=...)` are not visible here;
force them with `type_overrides=` instead.

### `from_include` {#strawchemy-dto-types-DTOConfig-from_include}

```python
from_include(include: FieldSpec | Literal[False] | None = None, purpose: Purpose = Purpose.READ) -> Self
```

Create a DTOConfig from an include specification.

Factory method for creating a DTOConfig with a simplified interface, converting
an `IncludeFields` specification into a complete configuration object. This is
useful for building configs when only the include/exclude specification matters.

**Parameters:**

Name | Type | Description | Default
---- | ---- | ----------- | -------
`include` | <code>FieldSpec \| Literal[False] \| None</code> | The field inclusion specification. Can be: - None: Include no fields (converted to empty set) - "all": Include all fields - list or set of field names: Include only these specific fields Defaults to None. | <code>None</code>
`purpose` | <code>Purpose</code> | The purpose of the DTO being configured (READ, WRITE, or COMPLETE). Defaults to Purpose.READ. | <code>READ</code>

**Returns:**

Type | Description
---- | -----------
<code>Self</code> | A new DTOConfig instance with the specified include and purpose settings.
<code>Self</code> | All other configuration parameters use their defaults.

### `with_base_annotations` {#strawchemy-dto-types-DTOConfig-with_base_annotations}

```python
with_base_annotations(base: type[Any]) -> DTOConfig
```

Merge type annotations from a base class into this DTOConfig.

**Parameters:**

Name | Type | Description | Default
---- | ---- | ----------- | -------
`base` | <code>type[Any]</code> | The base class to extract type annotations from | *required*

**Returns:**

Type | Description
---- | -----------
<code>[DTOConfig](#strawchemy-dto-types-DTOConfig)</code> | A new DTOConfig instance with:
<code>[DTOConfig](#strawchemy-dto-types-DTOConfig)</code> | - Type annotations from the base class merged into annotation_overrides
<code>[DTOConfig](#strawchemy-dto-types-DTOConfig)</code> | - Updated include set to include all fields if exclude is specified or include was "all"

The method handles two cases:
1. When include is "all" or exclude is specified: All fields from the base class are included
2. When specific fields are included: Only those fields are added to the include set
